# Kenney prototype assets

Author: Kenney.

Original packs and license evidence:

- https://kenney.nl/assets/space-kit
- https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit
- CC0 1.0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Delivery mirror: https://github.com/Hidencod/tge-assets

The original publisher's ZIP downloads returned HTTP 403 in this environment. These self-contained GLB conversions were obtained from the CC0 mirror. Its license statement is preserved in LICENSE.txt. Exact file URLs, sizes and hashes are in outputs/planning/test-asset-manifest.json.

Selected files: a rover, generator, satellite dish, structural piece, three rock shapes and a cliff piece. The rover is a static single-mesh placeholder and includes no animation clips. These are technical test assets; they do not replace the selected rover or environment art direction.
